label: Sites shipped
detail: Every one is live, and every owner edits it without calling me.

label: Degrees
detail: B.S. in Computer Engineering, May 2026. M.S. in progress, thesis track, expected May 2028.

label: Day job plot twist
detail: I've done ownership research for oil, gas and renewable projects since 2020. It's why I built Landspace.

label: Why water matters
detail: My little brother drowned in our backyard pool at 14 months old. He survived. Because of ADAM is everything we wish we'd known.

label: Shots per match
detail: RAMpage carried enough air for 17 plow strikes. The firmware counted every one and locked out at zero.

label: Radio workaround
detail: Real V2V runs at 5.9 GHz. The Pluto's radio tops out below that, so my link ran at 2.9.

label: Where the voice came from
detail: Because of ADAM sounds like my family because I wrote it from 113 Facebook posts my mom made over nine years.

label: How I got the research post
detail: Dr. Aldo Duarte recommended me for the ONR project based on the software-defined radio work in his communications design course.
